title: 손이 크다 ≠ big hands! Guess 3 Korean idioms in 3 seconds 🧶 #learnkorean
caption:
Can you guess these 3 Korean idioms in 3 seconds? 🧶

손이 크다 — not “big hands”: generous (cooks way too much!)
발이 넓다 — not “wide feet”: knows lots of people
눈이 높다 — not “high eyes”: has high standards

Say it: 손이 커요 · 발이 넓어요 · 눈이 높아요

How many did you get? Comment your score 0/3 – 3/3 👇
Good luck on TOPIK 108! 화이팅!

SYNK LAB · Korean idiom quiz with Mongle.
#learnkorean #koreanlanguage #studykorean #TOPIK
alt: Felt mascot Mongle hosts a Korean idiom quiz. Felt hands, feet and eyes show the literal readings of 손이 크다, 발이 넓다 and 눈이 높다, then a table piled with dumplings, a network of felt friends and an eye on a tall pedestal show the real meanings.
